item.title: Secure DNS: setting up DNS over HTTPS in OPNsense with Unbound DNS
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step guide to configuring DNS over HTTPS (DoT) in OPNsense for secure and encrypted domain name resolution. Covers configuring DNS services, setting up certificates, and verifying operation on client devices.
